newsitem.title: USA: Nev. legislature clears electric deregulation bill.
newsitem.headline: Nev. legislature clears electric deregulation bill.

text.p: The Nevada legislature over the weekend passed a bill allowing competition in the state's electricity industry by December 1999, a spokesman for the Nevada Public Service Commission (PSC) said Monday.
The bill will now go to Nevada Governor Bob Miller, who is expected to sign it into law.
The legislation includes consumer protection measures as well as guarantees for system reliablity.
The bill also makes provisions for the state's current monopoly utilities to recover investments expected to become unprofitable under market competition.
Actual accounting for those costs, however, will be done through the PSC, the regulatory agency noted.
